one_line: Open on finished covers in hand with a first-person line: this is already our third book.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down handheld shot of a hardcover whose cover shows an illustrated baby boxing champion; no overlay text yet. Voice from 0:00 (transcript): "וזה כבר הספר השלישי שלנו משם." Subtitles from 0:01: "קיבלתי את הספר", "שיצרתי", "במיבוק,".
q1_hook.why: A vivid cover in motion from the first frame, with a voice at once (H1, S1). "Already our third book" is a first-hand repeat-buyer signal (S6). But it names no benefit until about 0:07 (H2), and no text card or question stops the scroll (T3).

beats.what: Boxing cover top-down; birthday and dinosaur covers slide in; "קיבלתי את הספר" ... "במיבוק,"
beats.why: A striking product and a repeat-buyer claim at once

beats.what: Each of the three covers in turn, about 1.5 s each; "ההליך" ... "וזה עושה את זה כל"
beats.why: Fast tour of the three books backs up "third book"

beats.what: Close-up of hands on a baby's belly on a changing mat; "ועד שהתוצאה", "זרם בקלות."
beats.why: New scene, but unrelated to the book or the claim

beats.what: Static wide shot: mother and baby, seen from behind, with the book before a TV; "אחרי המקלחת."
Over-the-shoulder close-ups of two pages; "ומראה לו את התמונות והסיפור."
beats.why: The first look inside the book, 25 s in

beats.what: Wide shot again, book open; "פשוט מרגש אותי בכל פעם מחדש" held about 4 s
beats.why: The emotional line lands over a calm shot

beats.what: Back cover with a round portrait and QR code held up; "אין דבר מושלם יותר מזה."
beats.why: Ends on the product and the closing line

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. The caption has no question and no ask to comment, share or save, only a coupon line.
q2_flow.why: The first 12 s change every 1.5 s, which keeps it moving (R3). The belly clip at 0:12 breaks the story (R1), and two static shots of 9 to 10 s carry only the voice with the baby facing away (R1, K8). The ritual is warm, but low in surprise (K1).

q3_cta.what: None in the video; the last subtitle is "אין דבר מושלם יותר מזה." (0:38). Caption line 2: "אירגנתי לכן קוד קופון: baram". No comment word, no link, no question.
q3_cta.why: One ask, a coupon code, a real benefit (C1, C2), but only in the caption: the video never says or shows it. The back cover with a QR code is held up at 0:37 to 0:40 unexplained, so the end offers no next step (C6).

q4_shown.what: Three finished covers (boxing, birthday, dinosaur) with the child's name printed on them, 0:00-0:12; a baby's belly massage 0:12-0:15; mother and baby reading before a TV; two interior illustrations 0:25-0:31; the back cover and QR code 0:37-0:40. No price, no screen recording.
q4_shown.why: Three covers in a row plus "הספר השלישי" make a first-hand repeat-buyer proof (S6, S1). The name on each cover is visible, but no photo of the child sits beside a page (S2). The ordering is said to be easy, never shown (S8).

q5_edit.what: 9 shots in 41 s, about 4.6 s each. Hard cuts, no visible speed changes. Four cuts in 12 s, then shots of 3 to 10 s. Subtitles change every 1 s early, held 3 to 4 s late. Ends on the back cover.
q5_edit.why: The quick cover tour fits the moderate pace (E2). The 9 to 10 s static holds are long (R1). Synced subtitles let it work muted (E4). It ends with the closing line and no dead tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A parent's testimonial about a third personalised book and an after-bath reading ritual with a baby. It serves a parent who wants a calm evening moment.
q6_topic.why: Bedtime routine is an everyday parent concern, and the claim is emotional, not developmental (K6, K4). Warmth is the feeling, with no peak or surprise (K1). A small arc runs from "third book" to "השקט שלנו" (K2).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down close-ups of covers on a white shelf; a close-up of hands on a changing mat; a static high-angle wide shot of mother and baby from behind before a TV, in warm lamp light; handheld over-the-shoulder page close-ups. No face.
q7_filmed.why: Home, lamp light and a real routine read as a creator video (H8, F7). Over-the-shoulder pages put the viewer in the reader's seat (F5). In the wide shot the book is small and a bright TV fills the top third (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: White subtitles, no box, 1 to 2 lines, near the bottom (about 90% down): "קיבלתי את הספר" (0:01), "שיצרתי" (0:02), "במיבוק," (0:03), "וזה כבר הספר השלישי" (0:04), "זרם בקלות." (0:15), "אחרי המקלחת." (0:23), "ומראה לו את התמונות והסיפור." (0:27), "פשוט מרגש אותי בכל פעם מחדש" (0:32), "אין דבר מושלם יותר מזה." (0:38). No headline card, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "לפני השינה, אנחנו בוחרים ספר, מדפדפים ומתחברים לרגעים הקטנים שלנו יחד." About 35 words: a bedtime sentence naming "ספרי מייבוק", then "אירגנתי לכן קוד קופון: baram", then "בשיתוף: @mebook.ai". No question, no hashtags.
q8_text.why: Subtitles echo every spoken line in short chunks, so it works muted (T1, T2), but they sit at the very bottom, inside the zone the interface covers (T4, F2). The caption has searchable words (book, bedtime, child) but no hashtags (T7), and the partnership is on its last line (T8).

weak_points: An unrelated belly-massage clip; two static 9 to 10 s shots with the baby facing away; a bright TV pulling the eye from the book; the process claimed, not shown; no CTA on screen; subtitles at the very bottom.
lumebook_takeaway: Film finished covers top-down in hand, one per 1.5 s, with a first-person line; show the preview screen once; end with the offer written on screen.
